idea: I tried living on ₹500 a day in Mumbai for a full week: food, travel, everything
audience: college students and first-job people in metro cities

hooks.en: Can you survive Mumbai on ₹500 a day?
hooks.hi: क्या ₹500 रोज़ में मुंबई में जी सकते हो?
hooks.hinglish: Kya ₹500 roz mein Mumbai survive ho sakta hai?
hooks.shot: A ₹500 note held up in front of a crowded local train platform.
hooks.why: Every viewer instantly guesses an answer, and has to watch to see if they were right.

hooks.en: ₹500 a day in Mumbai is enough. I proved it.
hooks.hi: मुंबई में ₹500 रोज़ काफ़ी है। मैंने करके दिखाया।
hooks.hinglish: Mumbai mein ₹500 roz kaafi hai. Maine karke dikhaya.
hooks.shot: You on day 7, fanning out a week of small receipts toward the camera.
hooks.why: Most people believe the opposite, so the claim starts an argument in their head.

hooks.shot: A notebook page with ₹3,500 written at the top and seven empty rows.
hooks.why: One hard number makes the challenge concrete before you say anything else.

hooks.en: Day 3, I had ₹42 left and no lunch.
hooks.hi: तीसरे दिन मेरे पास ₹42 बचे थे, और लंच नहीं हुआ था।
hooks.hinglish: Day 3 tak sirf ₹42 bache the, aur lunch baaki tha.
hooks.shot: Coins counted out on your palm next to a vada pav stall.
hooks.why: Starting in the middle of trouble makes people stay to see how it ends.

hooks.en: POV: your whole day in Mumbai costs ₹500.
hooks.hi: POV: मुंबई में पूरा दिन सिर्फ़ ₹500 में।
hooks.hinglish: POV: Mumbai mein poora din sirf ₹500 mein.
hooks.shot: First-person shot tapping a metro card at the gate.
hooks.why: Students on a tight budget see their own life, so it feels made for them.

hooks.en: My biggest mistake was on day one: auto rickshaws.
hooks.hi: सबसे बड़ी गलती पहले ही दिन हुई: ऑटो।
hooks.hinglish: Sabse badi galti pehle din hi hui: auto.
hooks.shot: An auto meter ticking up, then a cut to your face reacting.
hooks.why: People watch to avoid a mistake they might make themselves.
